title: Smart Brain v3 Hardening — Shawn Note

source.path: Naya Power Smart Brain v3 Hardening execution on 2026-08-25

summary: We are moving from a well-designed Smart Notes system to a genuinely enforced Superbrain. It must be organized, retrievable, verifiable, testable, and able to compound learning instead of depending on a future AI to remember the rules.
what_happened: The Superbrain hardening pass converted constitutional memory rules into executable runtime and CI boundaries while preserving canonical events as source truth.
what_we_learned: The system has to prove it works, not just describe how it should work.
Time organizes memory, meaning connects it, indexing retrieves it, and verification earns trust.
Every meaningful execution should leave the brain stronger than it was before.
why_it_matters: The brain becomes a durable operating system for continuity and learning rather than a pile of disconnected notes.
what_changed: Established executable continuity and project contracts.
Added machine-checked receipts, paired representations, learning capture, and ready-to-run Next Execution handoff enforcement.
Added intelligence-layer tests for idempotency, resolution, supersession, outbox, health, and retrieval baseline.
next_best_action: Continue the remaining intelligence gaps in dependency order, starting with stronger entity-resolution persistence and semantic retrieval measurement while protecting the green foundation.
content: The important change is that the brain now proves what it did and leaves the next AI a continuation path.

evidence: Canonical event exists in the required chronological bucket.
